description: Phase 4: database-backed public content. Pinned deps, Docker-free local Postgres (embedded-postgres) with the local-DB fence, Prisma 7 schema + init migration, idempotent seed from src/content/demo/* and defaultSiteSettings, content.ts/site-settings swap to Prisma (PUBLISHED only, ne->en fallback), consumer components switched to settings (header LAYOUT unchanged), Vitest unit/db projects, proxy/robots/sitemap /admin exclusion, Playwright public project on a seeded mission_test DB. Implements plan.md items 0-4. Must land first: FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on the schema, db.ts, test harness and e2e-prepare.
steps: Plan item 0: run `npm test` and `npx playwright test --reporter=list` on the untouched tree; create c:/Users/rasaily/Downloads/mission app/.agents/tasks/phase4-5/verification.md with a Baseline section (expected 55 unit / 38 E2E; record real numbers).

Plan item 1: `npm view <pkg>@<ver> version` for every package in design §2, then `npm install --save-exact` (deps and dev deps listed in plan item 1; prisma@7.10.1 not the 8.0.0-rc latest). Create prisma.config.ts (§3.3), scripts/local-db.ts (§3.2), scripts/assert-local-db.ts (§3.2a) + scripts/assert-local-db.test.ts, add the §3.4 npm scripts, update .gitignore (.local/, src/generated/, playwright/.auth/), eslint.config.mjs globalIgnores (.local/**, src/generated/**), .prettierignore (.local, src/generated). Create local untracked .env with DATABASE_URL to mission_dev, empty DIRECT_URL, generated AUTH_SECRET and TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Run the pinned `npx prisma@7.10.1 dev` probe and clean it up; record result.

Plan item 2: prisma/schema.prisma exactly per §4.2; `npm run db:migrate -- --name init`; src/config/site.ts -> siteConfig + getSiteConfig + defaultSiteSettings (§5, copy Home.heroEyebrow/missionStatement/introBody1+2 values verbatim for en and ne); src/config/social.ts; remove the 4 Home keys from messages/en.json and messages/ne.json and add MediaKinds.IMAGE (Image / तस्बिर); src/lib/prisma-factory.ts; prisma/seed-lib.ts (seedDemoContent, create-only upserts keyed on demo ids, mapping per §5) and prisma/seed.ts.

Plan item 3: src/lib/db.ts (server-only), localize.ts, content-mappers.ts, rewrite content.ts (same 5 exports; getFeaturedVerse(now) nullable), site-settings-mappers.ts, site-settings.ts (React cache, defaults on missing row, errors propagate); src/app/fonts.ts extracted from src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx; update Header.tsx/Footer.tsx (data source only, optional logoUrl img), Hero.tsx, MinistryIntro.tsx, FeaturedContent.tsx, PlaceholderPage.tsx, [locale]/layout.tsx (DemoBanner iff isDemo), metadata.ts (siteName param), [locale]/page.tsx (nullable verse, revalidate = 3600). Split vitest.config.mts into unit/db projects per §17.1; create src/test/{empty-module,db-global-setup,db-setup,factories}.ts. Rename src/lib/content.test.ts -> src/lib/content.db.test.ts keeping the 9 case names; add DRAFT exclusion, ne fallback and featured-verse precedence cases; add prisma/seed.db.test.ts, src/lib/site-settings.db.test.ts, src/lib/content-mappers.test.ts, src/lib/site-settings-mappers.test.ts. If next build cannot bundle the generated client, add only serverExternalPackages: ["@prisma/adapter-pg", "pg"] and record it.

Plan item 4: src/proxy.ts segment-anchored matcher + isAdminPath wrapper; src/lib/admin-path.ts + admin-path.test.ts (extracts matcher literal from proxy.ts); robots.ts disallow ['/admin', '/api/']; src/app/sitemap.test.ts and robots.test.ts; scripts/e2e-prepare.ts (§3.5 steps 1-4 only; users come in FEAT-002) and e2e/global-teardown.ts; playwright.config.ts with webServer `npm run e2e:prepare && npm run build && npm run start -- -p 3210`, env DATABASE_URL + DIRECT_URL = mission_test URL, random AUTH_SECRET/TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY, NO E2E flag, reuseExistingServer false, timeout 600000, globalTeardown, project `public` matching the 6 existing specs.
Run `npm run format`, then all verification commands; append evidence for items 0-4 to verification.md.
acceptance_criteria: Select-String -Path package.json -Pattern '"[\^~]' returns nothing; prisma and @prisma/client are 7.10.1; next-auth is 5.0.0-beta.32
npm run db:start starts Postgres on 127.0.0.1:54329, second run is a no-op, db:status reports running, db:stop stops it
$env:DIRECT_URL="postgresql://u:p@ep-x.neon.tech/db"; npm run db:reset exits 1 before Prisma runs
npx prisma migrate status reports up to date; npm run db:seed twice exits 0 with identical counts
npm test passes both projects; the 9 former content tests pass in content.db.test.ts with identical names; DRAFT rows never returned; ne blank falls back to en
npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run format:check, npm run build (DB up, seeded) exit 0
npx playwright test --project=public passes the baseline 38 tests with unchanged assertions; home screenshots show the unchanged header layout and seeded content
/robots.txt disallows /admin; sitemap has no /admin URL; /admin, /admin/posts do not match the proxy matcher while /administration does
verification: npm run db:start; npm run db:status
npm run db:seed; npm run db:seed
findings: Baseline: 55 unit (8 files) / 38 E2E, as expected. After FEAT-001: unit 74 (13 files), db 22 (3 files), npm test 96 (16 files), E2E public 38. Migration folder: prisma/migrations/20261026013432_init. UNVERIFIED outcomes: createRequire of the platform pkg works under tsx (no async fallback); prisma generate works with no DATABASE_URL at all (no placeholder); Turbopack bundles the Prisma client without serverExternalPackages (next.config.ts untouched); pinned prisma@7.10.1 dev probe (@prisma/dev 0.24.17) accepted a second pg client for simple queries (decision stands, probe removed). Helpers created: scripts/local-db.ts exports PORT, HOST, USER, PASSWORD, ROOT_DIR, LOCAL_DIR, DATA_DIR, DATABASES, urlFor, ensureInitialised, isRunning, ensureDatabase, recreateDatabase, start (async, returns {startedNow}), stop, runPrisma; scripts/assert-local-db.ts exports assertLocalDbUrls (accepts process.env directly) + LocalDbGuardError. src/lib/prisma-factory.ts createPrismaClient(url); src/lib/db.ts prisma; src/lib/localize.ts pick; src/lib/content-mappers.ts (view-model types + toPostSummary/toEventSummary/toMediaSummary/toVerseView/mediaDisplayKind; content.ts re-exports the types); src/lib/site-settings.ts getSiteSettings (React cache) + getLocalizedSiteSettings(locale); src/lib/site-settings-mappers.ts toLocalizedSiteSettings(row, locale, onInvalidSocial?), storedSocialLinkSchema, parseStoredSocialLinks, splitParagraphs. src/lib/admin-path.ts isAdminPath. src/app/fonts.ts exports lora, inter, notoSansDeva, notoSerifDeva (for the admin layout). prisma/seed-lib.ts seedDemoContent(prisma) -> {posts,events,verses,media,settings}, DEMO_FEATURED_VERSE_DATE. Test harness: src/test/db-setup.ts mocks next/cache (revalidatePath, revalidateTag, updateTag spies, unstable_cache passthrough), next/headers (cookie jar + Headers, exported as testRequest), next/navigation (redirect/notFound throw NavigationSignal{kind,location}; unstable_rethrow rethrows it); exports resetDb() (TRUNCATE all Prisma.ModelName tables, clears cookie jar), NavigationSignal, testRequest. The @/auth mock and setTestSession are NOT there yet (src/auth.ts does not exist): FEAT-002 must add vi.mock('@/auth') in db-setup.ts. src/test/factories.ts has makePost, makeEvent, makeMedia, makeVerse (Partial<...UncheckedCreateInput> overrides); add makeOwner/makeEditor there. Deviations: (1) vitest.config.mts and playwright.config.ts use literal mission_unit/mission_test URLs instead of importing urlFor (db-global-setup asserts equality with urlFor; e2e-prepare refuses any other URL). (2) e2e/global-teardown.ts cannot import scripts/local-db.ts (Playwright loads it as CJS, import.meta fails); it stops Postgres by spawning process.execPath + resolved tsx/cli 'scripts/local-db.ts stop'. Any future Playwright-side file (auth.setup, helpers) must not import scripts/local-db.ts either. (3) src/lib/log.ts does not exist yet: site-settings.ts uses console.warn('[site-settings.social.invalid]', {count}); swap to log.warn('site-settings.social.invalid') in FEAT-002. (4) storedSocialLinkSchema lives in site-settings-mappers.ts; validation/settings.ts can import/reuse it. (5) defaultSiteSettings is a 'satisfies Omit<SiteSettings,id|updatedAt>' object (socialLinks: []). (6) scripts/e2e-prepare.ts runs main() unconditionally (CLI only); FEAT-002 adds user creation after the seed step. Gotcha: in PowerShell, writing .env via node -e with embedded quotes mangles it; use a temp .cjs file. Local Postgres left running at the end of FEAT-001; .next was last built against mission_test by Playwright.
